author: ZaneIce
quote: This the worst GTA game I’ve played the character are bland and story is predictable it’s only redeeming quality is it’s graphics, it’s genuinely sad how a hype game like this turned out to be a boring slop fest, taking away features we had in previous rockstar tiles is genuinely confusing to me, GTA 6 took 13 years to come out and ended up being the most overhyped game ever made.
